_comment: Join table: plan file <-> Notion Roadmap row <-> Notion Tracker row. Plan files are authoritative; Notion rows mirror them. See ~/.claude/references/notion-roadmap-sync.md.

pending_backfill._why: The Roadmap DB had zero AEC rows as of 2026-08-18. Only the in-flight plan was given a row; the rest need their real merge status verified against origin/main (invariant 2) before a row is created, which is a separate pass.

known_drift: plans/ROADMAP.md Tier 2 links docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-19-org-config-overlay-phase-2.md, which does not exist; the file on disk is 2026-05-25-org-config-overlay-phase-4.md.
invariants: 1. Every non-archived plan file has a Roadmap row, or an entry in pending_backfill/completed_unmapped naming why it has none.
2. Never mark a Roadmap row Done unless the work is on origin/main. Verify with git log/git ls-tree, not the plan file's checkboxes. Unmerged work is Blocked with the branch named.
3. The Tracker holds work in flight only (Ready / In progress / Blocked-on-a-human). Backlog lives in the Roadmap DB alone.
4. Drift check: shasum -a 256 <plan file> vs source_sha256 and the row's Source SHA. Editing a plan file refreshes both in the same turn.
5. Notion updates happen in the same turn the work ships - never batched to end of session.
